@graph.comment: ViewAssembler (view-layer spec §3.1) — executes the view descriptors' declared CONSTRUCT/SELECT projection queries via embedded @comunica/query-sparql over EXPLICIT sources (no link traversal; the Pod hosts no SPARQL endpoint per D3/D29). Parameterless: engine + serializers are constructed internally. Shared by both view HTTP handlers.

ViewHttpHandler — per-resource ?_profile= conneg (view-layer spec §4; read-path corrected by D114; selection stripped by SP2-T7): the ONLY served token is fused, over resources in ANY tree (fused is the substrate-wide, content-type-agnostic governed-context contract: markdown -> body + fenced graph; RDF -> resource triples unioned with .meta as one prefixed turtle graph, ResponseMetadata bookkeeping filtered). Inserted BEFORE LdpHandler in the BaseHttpHandler waterfall (same QSA-interception precedent as WikiSearchHttpHandler / MementoHttpHandler), so ?_profile-shaped GETs are claimed before standard LDP processing and fall through (NotImplementedHttpError) otherwise. ?_profile=alt also falls through to LDP (token retired). A missing base resource is written as HTTP 404 by the handler itself (a thrown error would hit HandlerServerConfigurator's blanket 500). store = urn:solid-server:default:ResourceStore = the MonitoringStore instance. baseUrl is the deployment baseUrl variable (NOT a literal); viewsBase is the pod-specific view-descriptor container (hardcoded string, same idiom as the AdmissionFloor stampPredicate / markdown-render storagePath). (D114 removed the doc/graph tokens + the TrailerDecoratingStore.)

IndexViewListener (SP2 Task 5; RQ-Discovery-1 fork a: on-write static index.md child — the probe-validated definition-line index, see spec §7 of 2026-06-10-agentic-progressive-disclosure-contract-design). Subscribes to MonitoringStore 'changed' events; on a direct-member write in a registered wiki container, regenerates that container's index.md (frontmatter-typed sub:ContainerIndex — honestly-typed derived view) and merges derivation provenance (prov:wasDerivedFrom container / prov:wasGeneratedBy the container-index view descriptor / prov:generatedAtTime) into index.md.meta. containers = the six DURABLE wiki containers; /working/ is excluded by design (D73 two-stage commit: drafts are not navigable members-of-record until crystallized). K1 note: this listener is wired into the WorkerParallelInitializer Override in mem-trigger.json (the single K1-compliant consolidation point for all listener handlers).

ViewSpaceHttpHandler — the /vault/views/ cross-cutting virtual URL space (view-layer spec §6; Person demonstrator at /vault/views/people/). Read-only; assembles one entity from its multiple writable homes via a descriptor CONSTRUCT, sources enumerated through the Type Index (no source hardcode, D107). Inserted BEFORE LdpHandler alongside ViewHttpHandler. Same Monitoring-level store ref as ViewHttpHandler (bypasses the trailer). viewSpaceRoot = the served container path; typeIndexUrl = the Type Index used to enumerate person-class source containers.
